nodes.name: GroupRowEraTag.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a compact colored tag distinguishing the latest model generation from older lineups on grouped model table rows.

nodes.name: ModelTableTooltipContent.tsx
nodes.summary: Small presentational component rendering tooltip content for a model entry in the model table.

nodes.name: ModelVariantInlineCard.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders an inline card that groups and displays a model's reasoning-effort/speed variants as selectable pills, and lets the user pick a default variant per base model.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Defines shared constant tokens and color mappings used across the ModelTable component family, including input-value sentinel tokens and era tag colors.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Main ModelTable component entry point that composes column building, grouping, expansion, and search hooks into a single configurable table for enabling/disabling and managing AI models.

nodes.name: modelGroupExpandable.tsx
nodes.summary: Provides a hook and helper for determining which grouped model rows can expand to show individual variants, and builds the expanded sub-row rendering configuration.

nodes.name: modelTableColumnHelpers.tsx
nodes.summary: Collection of reusable cell renderers and helpers (icon select, enabled switch, catalog/unified/custom model cells, group summary) shared by the ModelTable's flat and grouped column builders.

nodes.name: modelTableColumnTypes.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions describing the row and argument shapes shared by the ModelTable's flat and group column builder functions.

nodes.name: modelTableFlatColumns.tsx
nodes.summary: Builds the ant-design column definitions for the flat (non-grouped) catalog and unified model table views, wiring in enable/disable switches and edit cells.

nodes.name: modelTableGroupColumns.tsx
nodes.summary: Builds the grouped-view column definitions for the ModelTable, including the preferred/default-variant column that lets users pick a default reasoning variant per group.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines shared size constants used to keep controls (switches, inputs) visually consistent across the ModelTable component family.

nodes.name: unifiedCustomFlatExtras.tsx
nodes.summary: Supplies the custom-model name/display-name input components and the useUnifiedCustomFlatHandlers hook that implements add/rename/remove/test logic for user-defined custom models and aliases.

nodes.name: useModelTableColumns.tsx
nodes.summary: Hook that assembles the flat catalog, flat unified, and grouped column sets for the ModelTable based on view mode and current state, re-exporting the group-expansion helpers.

nodes.name: useModelTableData.ts
nodes.summary: Core data hook for the ModelTable: derives model families, groups, filters (family/status/era), search-filtered flat and group rows, and manages expansion state for the table's model catalog.

nodes.name: GroupRowEraTag
nodes.summary: Functional component rendering a mini colored tag showing whether a model group is the current or a non-current era.

nodes.name: ModelTableTooltipContent
nodes.summary: Default-exported component that renders the tooltip body shown for a model entry.

nodes.name: getRawSuffixTokens
nodes.summary: Extracts the raw suffix tokens (portion of a model name beyond its base model) as a lowercase token array.

nodes.name: getReasoningEffortMeta
nodes.summary: Computes display metadata (label, sort order) for a model variant's reasoning-effort level, falling back to its raw suffix when no standard level is detected.

nodes.name: groupVariantsByEffort
nodes.summary: Groups a base model's variants by reasoning-effort/speed/models metadata into sorted display groups for pill rendering.

nodes.name: getPillLabel
nodes.summary: Derives the short label text shown on a variant selector pill, factoring in group type (GPT/O-series/Composer) and raw suffix formatting.

nodes.name: ModelVariantInlineCard
nodes.summary: Default-exported component that renders a base model's variants as an inline grouped pill selector, letting the user preview and confirm a default variant.

nodes.name: ModelTable
nodes.summary: Default-exported top-level component that renders the configurable model table, wiring together data, column, expansion, and custom-model hooks with search and view-mode toggling.

nodes.name: groupRowHasParsedVariants
nodes.summary: Exported helper that checks whether a group row has any models with parsed variant metadata available.

nodes.name: useModelGroupExpandable
nodes.summary: Hook that computes which grouped rows are expandable and builds the expanded sub-row keys and cell renderers for showing individual model variants under a group.

nodes.name: getModelAlias
nodes.summary: Exported helper that looks up a model's alias entry by model name from a list of model aliases.

nodes.name: renderModelIconSelect
nodes.summary: Renders the icon-provider select control used in editable model rows, showing an override indicator when applicable.

nodes.name: renderEnabledSwitchCell
nodes.summary: Renders the enable/disable switch cell for a model row, reflecting and toggling its membership in the enabled-models set.

nodes.name: renderCatalogModelCell
nodes.summary: Renders the read-only display cell for a catalog (built-in) model, showing its full formatted name.

nodes.name: renderUnifiedModelEditCell
nodes.summary: Renders the editable cell used for unified (catalog + custom) model rows, combining icon select, name/alias editing, and a remove button.

nodes.name: renderCustomGroupEditCell
nodes.summary: Renders the editable cell for custom models within a grouped row, allowing icon, name, and alias edits plus removal.

nodes.name: renderGroupSummaryCell
nodes.summary: Renders the summary cell for a model group row, showing group label and aggregate info.

nodes.name: renderExpandedCatalogModelCell
nodes.summary: Renders the model-name cell for a catalog model shown inside an expanded group sub-row.

nodes.name: renderExpandedUnifiedModelCell
nodes.summary: Renders the editable model-name cell for a unified model shown inside an expanded group sub-row, including icon select and alias editing.

nodes.name: getGroupEnabledState
nodes.summary: Exported helper computing whether a group's models are fully, partially, or not enabled, for driving the group-level enable switch state.

nodes.name: renderRemoveButton
nodes.summary: Renders the remove/delete icon button used on custom model rows to trigger row removal.

nodes.name: buildFlatCatalogColumns
nodes.summary: Builds the column definitions for the flat catalog (built-in models only) table view, including sortable name and enabled-switch columns.

nodes.name: buildFlatUnifiedColumns
nodes.summary: Builds the column definitions for the flat unified (catalog + custom) table view, including editable name and enabled-switch columns.

nodes.name: buildGroupColumns
nodes.summary: Exported function building the grouped-view column set, wiring group label, preferred-version, and group-level enable switch columns.

nodes.name: buildPreferredVersionColumn
nodes.summary: Builds the single column definition responsible for rendering the preferred/default-variant picker for a model group.

nodes.name: renderPreferredVersionCell
nodes.summary: Renders the cell content for choosing a group's preferred/default model variant, computing options and resolving the currently selected default.

nodes.name: buildIconSelectOptions
nodes.summary: Exported helper building the dropdown options list for icon-provider selection, with display labels derived from provider ids.

nodes.name: newCustomRowId
nodes.summary: Exported helper generating a short random id for a newly created custom model row.

nodes.name: newPlaceholderModelName
nodes.summary: Exported helper producing a placeholder model name derived from a new custom row's id, used before the user names the model.

nodes.name: isPlaceholderModelName
nodes.summary: Exported helper checking whether a given model name is still an auto-generated placeholder rather than a user-provided name.

nodes.name: CustomModelNameInput
nodes.summary: Exported input component for editing a custom model's underlying name, committing changes on Enter/blur while showing placeholder state.

nodes.name: CustomModelDisplayNameInput
nodes.summary: Exported input component for editing a custom model's display alias, committing changes on Enter/blur.

nodes.name: useUnifiedCustomFlatHandlers
nodes.summary: Exported hook implementing add/rename/remove/test handlers for custom models and their aliases, plus icon-provider option derivation, used by the unified flat model table view.

nodes.name: useModelTableColumns
nodes.summary: Exported hook that memoizes and returns the appropriate column set (flat catalog, flat unified, or grouped) for the ModelTable based on current view mode and callbacks.

nodes.name: mergeGroupsByLabel
nodes.summary: Merges model groups that share the same display label into a single group, combining member models and taking the max representative sort weight.

nodes.name: useModelTableData
nodes.summary: Exported core hook computing model families, era/status filters, grouped and flat row derivations, search filtering, and row-expansion state for the ModelTable.
